about: Report-level golden cases (S3-13). Each case posts the stored kgCO2e of the named engine cases from cases.json as approved rows, reads GET /reports/ghg/scope3 and checks every category total equals the sum of its cases in kgCO2e / 1000, rounded once (D5). Checked by ci/api/tests/s3-13-reporting.test.cjs.

cases.formula: post ex-4.2 and ex-9.1, approve, read GET /reports/ghg/scope3 → Cat 4 = 5.00 t, Cat 9 = 1.60 t, Scope 3 = 6.60 t
cases.note: Moved from cases.json. The engine figures of ex-4.2 and ex-9.1 are checked by their own cases (S3-8); this case checks the report's sum and rounding.
